rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an ongoing situation that seems never to finish.

example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 jyu5 zan1 hai6 mou5 jyun4 mou5 liu5

rows.note: Use this for limitless time, supplies, praise, or other things portrayed as inexhaustible.

example.traditional: 佢嘅創意真係無窮無盡。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 cong3 ji3 zan1 hai6 mou4 kung4 mou4 zeon6

rows.note: Use this mainly in literary or formal wording for something that does not come to an end.

example.jyutping: sai3 gaan1 fu2 naan6 bat1 zeon6
